python3 -c "
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.shapes.group import GroupShape

def walk(shapes, indent=0):
    for sidx, shape in enumerate(shapes):
        prefix = '  ' * indent
        if shape.shape_type == 6:  # GROUP
            print(f'{prefix}shape[{sidx}] GROUP name={shape.name!r}')
            walk(shape.shapes, indent+1)
        elif shape.has_text_frame:
            tf = shape.text_frame
            text_preview = tf.text[:80].replace(chr(10), ' | ')
            print(f'{prefix}shape[{sidx}] name={shape.name!r} type={shape.shape_type} text={text_preview!r}')
            for pidx, para in enumerate(tf.paragraphs):
                print(f'{prefix}  para[{pidx}] align={para.alignment} text={para.text[:60]!r}')
        else:
            print(f'{prefix}shape[{sidx}] name={shape.name!r} type={shape.shape_type} (no text)')

p = Presentation('/home/user/Desktop/38_1.pptx')
for idx, slide in enumerate(p.slides, 1):
    if idx in [3, 4, 5]:
        print(f'=== Slide {idx} ===')
        walk(slide.shapes)
"

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

p = Presentation('/home/user/Desktop/38_1.pptx')

def find_first_textbox(shapes):
    """Walk through shapes (including groups) and return the first shape with non-empty text."""
    for shape in shapes:
        if shape.shape_type == 6:  # GROUP
            result = find_first_textbox(shape.shapes)
            if result is not None:
                return result
        elif shape.has_text_frame and shape.text_frame.text.strip():
            return shape
    return None

slides = list(p.slides)
